score: 0-10 = 0.7 x mean judgement (timing, framing, move, acting, props/graphics, look, join) + 0.3 x measured (0.5 aligned motion-energy correlation + 0.5 x min(1, SSIM/0.5)); SSIM on blurred luma at 180x320 with the caption band masked; dE = mean Lab difference of 8 px blocks
